title: On the affine parametrization of null geodesics in low regularity
summary: In low-regularity spacetimes and Lorentzian length spaces, achronal causal curves play the role of null (pre-)geodesics. Because of the lack of a geodesic equation, they do not come with a canonical parametrization. In this context, we discuss a notion of affine parametrization via limits of affinely parametrized timelike geodesics. However, we point out a major drawback: an example where this approximation procedures gives a non-unique result, in a way that even completeness or incompleteness of the limit null geodesic is not well-defined.
